crossRefs.note: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
You shall remember all the way which Yahweh your God has led you these forty years in the wilderness, that he might…
For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.
We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest…
But you know the proof of him, that as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.
Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be…
Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

translations.web: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
translations.bsb: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
translations.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus'
translations.asv: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the household of Aristobulus.
